title: Switzerland & Italy - Honeymoon Escape
highlights: Discover Switzerland and Italy like never before, witnessing their old-world charm through architectural masterpieces and the majestic Swiss Alps.
Experience the romance of Venice as you glide along its enchanting canals on a traditional gondola ride.
Visit the Lindt Home of Chocolates and marvel at the world's largest chocolate fountain, holding over 1,500 liters of melted chocolate.
Explore the iconic Duomo Di Milano, largest church in Italy and the third largest in the world, admiring its intricate detailing and architecture.
Feel the rush of adrenaline as you and your partner ascend to the summit of Mount Titlis, where you'll be greeted by jaw-dropping views of the majestic Swiss Alps.
inclusions: 3 nights stay in Zurich with breakfast

know_before_you_go: Please carry valid Ids and the Thrillophilia voucher.
Please depart on suggested timings to avoid any inconvenience.
International / Domestic flights are not included in the package
Visa assistance will be provided however charges are not included
Travel Insurance is recommended and charges are not included
Personal Expenses and mandatory hotel taxes (if any) will be paid by the travelers at the destination.
Invest in a Swiss Travel Pass if you are willing to travel through boats, trains, and cable cars.
Carry sunscreens to prevent yourself from getting sunburns at high altitudes.
It is advisable not to purchase bottled water from the supermarket as it is a complete waste of money. Switzerland provides some of the world’s cleanest and best-tasting tap water.
Don’t buy chocolates from the souvenir shops and airport kiosks. Instead, walk to the nearest supermarket if you want to have one.
Don’t carry much cash and use your credit card wherever required.
Carry warm and comfortable clothes on your honeymoon trip to Italy and Switzerland.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Zurich
days.desc: Welcome to the vibrant and modern city of Zurich. Upon arrival at Zurich Airport, activate your Swiss Pass and proceed to your hotel for check-in. The rest of the day is yours to explore at leisure. Wander through Zurich's charming Old Town (Altstadt) for café hopping or visit Bahnhofstrasse, the world-famous shopping street. Discover the city's major attractions like the Swiss National Museum, Kunsthaus Zurich, and more. After a day of sightseeing, return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Day Trip to Mount Titlis | Lucerne City tour + Cruise
days.desc: Begin your day by heading to Zürich Hbf Station to catch a train to Lucerne, using your Swiss Pass. From Lucerne, transfer to a train to Engelberg. Upon arrival, take a bus to the Titlisbahn cable car station. Ride the TITLIS ROTAIR, the world’s first revolving cable car, up to Mt. Titlis and enjoy the stunning panoramic views. Then, return to Lucerne for a guided walking tour of its charming Old Town. Explore city's highlights before returning to the hotel in Zurich.

Lucerne Walking Tour with Lake Lucerne Cruise

days.title: Visit the famous Lindt Home of Chocolate
days.desc: Start your day at a leisurely pace, then use your Swiss Pass to head to the Lindt Home of Chocolate. Explore the museum and delve into the history and evolution of Swiss chocolate. Marvel at the impressive 9-meter-tall chocolate fountain, crafted from 1,500 kg of real chocolate. Engage with interactive exhibits, learn about chocolate's origins and production process through an audio guide, and savor various flavors. Conclude your visit with some souvenir shopping before returning to your hotel.

items.title: Lindt Home of Chocolate Tickets | Zurich

days.title: Transfer to Milan from Zurich | Explore Duomo Di Milano
days.desc: Check out from your hotel and head to Zurich Hbf using your Swiss Pass. Board a direct train to Milan Centrale, soaking in the stunning views of picturesque scenery and charming villages along the way. Upon arrival, proceed to the hotel for check-in and relax for a while. Later, embark on a tour of the Duomo di Milano, the largest church in Italy and the third largest in the world. Discover Milan's rich history through the cathedral's museum before returning to your hotel.

items.title: Duomo Di Milano Tickets, Italy - Duomo di Milano: Skip The Line & Duomo Museum

days.title: Transfer to Venice from Milan | Gondola Ride Tour
days.desc: Bid adieu to Milan and check out. Board the train to Venice, taking in the scenic views of the countryside along the way. Upon arrival in Venice, head to your hotel for check-in and take some time to rest. In the evening, make your way to Campiello Traghetto for a gondola ride through the magnificent canals of Venice. Glide gracefully through the enchanting waterways, marveling at the city's iconic landmarks as you pass by. After this magical experience, return to your hotel for the night.

items.title: Venice Gondola Ride Italy - Private 30-Minute Gondola Ride by Day

days.title: Half-Day Murano Burano Sightseeing Trip
days.desc: Get ready to embark on an unforgettable tour of Murano and Burano. Head to Riva degli Schiavoni and hop on the boat to begin your journey. Sail to the historic island of Murano, renowned for its glass-blowing industry. Witness the mesmerizing art of glass formation. Next, move on to the charming island of Burano, famous for its exquisite crochet work and brilliantly colorful buildings. Take in the breathtaking vistas of Burano's attractions before heading back to your hotel.

items.title: Half-Day Murano Burano Sightseeing Trip, Venice - Murano & Burano Trip - Train Station Area

days.title: Departure
days.desc: It's time to head back home, taking with you a bag full of memories. After a leisurely breakfast, check out from your hotel and get transferred to Venice Airport to catch your flight.
